stemMarkdown: A can do a job in 18 days. B is 80% more efficient than A. How many days does B take to do the same job alone? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Being 80% more efficient means B works at $180\%$ of A's rate, so B takes $\dfrac{100}{180}$ of A's time: $18 \times \dfrac{100}{180} = 10.0$ days.
altSolutionMarkdown: Efficiency and time are inversely related — more efficient means proportionally fewer days.
